notes: Tail case, all units rewritten. U1 whole carriage (already green canopy) -> its green canopy to red, mask = canopy with the window opening excluded. U2 'driver' replaced by a jacket -> the side-step passenger's padded jacket replaced by a wool overcoat. U3 ref made specific (backpack hiker). U4 badge on a tiny far-left man -> red wool blanket over the nearer carriage horse.

difficulty.specific_protection_zh: 保留马车、乘员和林间道路环境。

preserve: 保留透过窗口可见的乘客、车厢底盘和车轮。
units.reason: Canopy is already green so 'dark green' was a near no-op; now red. Mask = canopy only (v2, SAM3), window and passengers excluded, no speckles.
